newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portucel sees pulp industry recovery 1997.
newsitem.headline: Portucel sees pulp industry recovery 1997.

text.p: Portugal's state-controlled pulp group Portucel said on Tuesday that restructuring the country's pulp and paper sector would heighten the benefits of an expected upturn in the international market in 1997.
"In 1997, the company will continue to achieve gains in productivity and cost efficiency that will enable it to benefit from the recovery in the industry which is expected in the current year."
A restructuring of the domestic industry would contribute to this trend, the company said in a statement announcing a 1.4 billion escudo loss for 1996 against a 18.1 billion profit the year before.
"These (positive) conditions could be reinforced by the restructuring of the pulp and paper sector in Portugal," Portucel said.
The government is studying a possible reorganisation of the sector with the help of national and international advisors.
